summary:
Independently verified homepage chooser strip + /both 301 retirement on branch harness-homepage-chooser-strip-draft. Flag OFF: page-status=false, SSR
body byte-identical to main's homeBody() (1041 chars, programmatic compare), no 'Choose a product' nav, no data-testid=homepage-chooser-strip in browser, /both, /both/ and /both?x=1 -> HTTP 301 Location: '/', browser goto /both lands on /, /harness 200 (shows gated 'isn't available yet' as expected). Flag ON (temporary upsert + backend restart + 18s wait): page-status=true, SSR contains exact '
\n
ORA by AUREM · AUREM LOOP harness
\n

', anonymous browser shows strip above hero (strip y=93, hero y=143.5), ora pill is SPAN with aria-current=page, harness pill is , clicking it navigates to /harness (full page renders), lower promo section renders, /both still 301. No console errors in either state, desktop + mobile. Flag REVERTED: doc deleted (original state had NO harness_page doc), backend restarted, page-status=false, curl / has no nav, browser shows no strip. Vitest (chooserStrip, harnessPromo, tokenWording: 18/18) and eslint on changed files pass. Both.jsx deleted, no imports remain.

issues: SSR no-JS nav has a ' · ' separator between links; the React strip has none (pill style) — cosmetic copy mismatch only, both have identical text/hrefs.

React strip only appears after the async /harness/page-status fetch resolves, so with flag ON the hero shifts down ~50px after first paint (small CLS). Acceptable for a draft; could reserve space or prefetch if CLS budget matters.
Mobile (390px): the two pills wrap onto two lines (strip height 91px). Readable, but a single row would look tidier.

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/Dockerfile nginx: 'location = /both' doesn't match '/both/' (Vite middleware handles both). Low priority since that stack is unused.
aurem-prod-fixes.mjs isHarnessPageEnabled caches failures for 15s as well (fail-closed) — fine, but a transient backend blip hides the strip for 15s.
Landing.jsx promo section (data-testid=aurem-loop-promo-section) is unchanged vs main (git diff has no changes to it) and still gated by the same harnessPageEnabled state.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/harness_flag_toggle.py (new test-only helper, no app code changed)
seed_data_creation: Temporarily upserted {flag:'harness_page', enabled:true} in feature_flags (no such doc existed before). Deleted it afterward (deleted_count=1) and restarted backend; final state matches the start: no doc, page-status=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `python3 /app/backend/tests/harness_flag_toggle.py on|off|show` and then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` plus wait about 16s for the vite plugin's 15s cache. The starting DB state was NO harness_page doc. 'off' deletes it to restore that state. The full vitest suite was not re-run; only the 3 related test files were.
